main_text.p: EX literis tuis, qvas R.P. Bertinus mihi reddidit, non minus humanitate, qvam eruditione refertis, qvam percepe-rim jucunditatem, verbis haud facile ex-plicare possem; non mediocrem enim benevolentiam, qva me, licet immeri-tum, profeqveris, mirifice testantur: & eximii semper aliquid afferunt, unde multa addiscere mihi usu venit; qva-propter ut illis aliquando, cum vacat, me recreare non pigeat, te etiam atqve etiam rogo. De eo, qvod scribis, in spe-cimine jam missō Pentateuchi Samarita-ni aliqvas te reperisse dictiones, perpe-ram in duas divisas, unam aut alteram plus media sui parte truncam, duasqve aut tres Chaldæis & Syris admodum in-solentes, si modo recte erant scriptæ, ni-hil certi affirmare audeo, cum specimen illud non à me, sed ab alio fuerit tran-scriptum, lingvæ penitus ignaro, & qvi pictoris more characteres effingebat, absqve qvod illos dignoscereret, ex qvo non mirum, si aliqva commisisset errata, nec eam ipse adhibuerim diligentiam, ut accu-

page.notes: Page number "186" is at the top left and is partly damaged; the last digit is doubtful. "missō" is partly blurred, and the mark over the o may be a macron or a stain. The drop cap "E" is a large woodcut-style initial joined to "X". The page ends mid-word ("accu-"), so the paragraph continues on the next page.
